Creative technologist and 3D artist in Cairo, Egypt. Projection mapping, laser and LED shows; ex-HUGO BOSS and SYMSON 3D artist; music video director.

# Hazem Zakaria — 3.141Hz

> Hazem Zakaria works as 3.141Hz, a creative technologist, 3D artist, projection-mapping artist and music video director in Cairo, Egypt.

His tools include TouchDesigner, Unreal Engine, Resolume, MadMapper, Cinema 4D, Blender, ComfyUI and Python. His initials H·Z are read as a frequency; pi is approximately 3.14. He is also known as Hazem Elhakeem and Hazem Zak.

## Where does he work?
Across Egypt: Cairo and Giza, the Red Sea and Sinai resorts (Sharm El-Sheikh, Hurghada, El Gouna, Sahl Hasheesh, Makadi Bay, Marsa Alam, Dahab), Ain Sokhna, the North Coast and El Alamein, Alexandria, Luxor and Aswan. He is available for shows across the Middle East and the Gulf.

## Career

- German University in Cairo: civil engineering.
- Cairo: self-taught 3D; 3D visuals for the Middle Eastern rap scene.
- Nov 2020, Cairo: 3D design & animation for Zaid Khaled x El Waili, "Lame" (official music video, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cLSMG0LA3gM): over 456,000 YouTube views.
- Cologne Game Lab (TH Köln) + ifs Internationale Filmschule Köln, Germany: MA in 3D Animation for Film & Games.
- Aug 2022 – May 2023, SYMSON, Rotterdam, Netherlands: 3D Generalist. The 3D for the scroll-animated dynamic-pricing page [symson.com/algorithm](https://www.symson.com/algorithm), models and animation for campaigns and webinars, and the company's visual asset library.
- Jul 2023 – Dec 2024, HUGO BOSS, Metzingen, Germany: 3D Artist in the web3 / immersive-tech team. The AR “Smart Mirror”, animated collection loops for BOSS 100 Years, and a Blender plugin for the team's workflow as his master's thesis.
- The Apic, Germany: full-time 3D; product renders for Amazon.
- 2026, Cairo: director, game development and video production for Manos, "Mali W Malo" (official visualizer, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yYaW_pDkwK8), supported by the 2048 Foundation: over 344,000 YouTube views and 222,000 across two Instagram reels. Next: an unreleased Da9ud song.
- Now, Cairo: projection-mapping, laser and LED shows for brand launches, car reveals and events.
